apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **Door and window state on «Двері і вікна»** (phones and the HA card). The head unit publishes the open state of the four doors,
  the hood and the tailgate (`door_*_open`, `hood_open`, `tailgate_open`) and the open percent of the four windows and the roof
  sunshade (`window_*_percent`, `sunshade_percent`), read straight from `autoservice` like the other Tier F values, and HA discovers
  them. The screen lists what is open («Відчинено: двері водія, капот, багажник», «Вікно водія відчинене · 30%», «Шторка даху
  відкрита · 50%», or «…зачинені» in green), draws each open part over the car (the passenger and rear doors were added to the
  Figma design for this) and shows the lock pill «Замкнено» / «Відімкнено». Only the closed values have been seen on the car so far.
- **Tire temperature** (`tire_temp_fl/fr/rl/rr`, °C) on the head unit's Дашборд tire card (the «В РОЗРОБЦІ» badge is gone)
  and as four HA sensors. Read from `autoservice` like the pressure, from the instrument cluster's TPMS ids
  (`INSTRUMENT_2IN1_*_TYRE_TEMPERATURE`), not the tire group that was scanned before. Seen on the car parked: 5/5/4/5 °C
  at 5 °C outside. The phones and the HA card show no tires yet (pressure included).
- **Trips: drives, idles, parkings and charging sessions** (`trips/`). The head unit cuts its timeline into records on
  its own 2 s / 15 s cadence: the ignition (bodywork power level OK, dev 1001 fid 315621418) going off or on always ends
  a record; ignition on before the first R/D/M/S of that session is an idle, from the first drive gear (gearbox auto mode,
  dev 1011 fid 555745336) until the ignition goes off is one drive, stops in P included; ignition off is a parking (ACC/ON
  from an opened door count as off); a charging session (`bms_state` 1, ends on unplug or 90 s outside 0/1/2/13) is its
  own record. Each record keeps start/end time, SOC, lifetime kWh, odometer, 12 V and position, the energy and charge
  integrated from pack V × I both ways (out, and regen/charging in), distance, kWh/100 km, max and average speed, and for
  drives a GPS track (a point every 25 m or 30 s; a missing, stale, CAN-contradicted or jumping fix is replaced by the
  last good position and flagged). Records shorter than a minute (a drive: under 0.1 km and 2 min) are dropped.
  Plain JSONL files on the storage chosen in Налаштування → Сховище → Поїздки, kept until deleted by hand; retained
  `<prefix>/<vehicle>/trips` (last 31 days, routes as encoded polylines) and `/trips/current` (the open record);
  HA sensors `Trips` and `Current Trip` carry them as attributes. New head-unit screen «Поїздки».
- **Routes in the phone apps and the HA card show the trips**: Сьогодні / Тиждень / Місяць, totals of the period's drives
  (distance, time driving, energy), the list of records, and the routes on the map (all drives of the period, or the
  tapped record alone).

### Fixed
- **The head unit's log is no longer 97 % permission warnings.** The app stopped calling the blocked Tier E reads of tire
  pressure/temperature and current trip info every snapshot; they were refused each time and logged a WARN, about 17,600
  lines a day, so the 5 MB log files rotated every couple of days. Tire pressure still comes from `autoservice` as before.
